# Knight Group Handyman Services LLC

> Registered and insured handyman services from Safety Harbor across Pinellas County and selected northwest Hillsborough and west Pasco routes. Recurring Home Watch remains Pinellas-focused. Call or text (813) 649-3341.

Knight Group Handyman Services LLC serves homeowners across Safety Harbor, Clearwater, Dunedin, Palm Harbor, Largo, Oldsmar, Seminole, St. Petersburg, Tampa, Temple Terrace, and nearby Pinellas, Hillsborough, and Pasco County communities with drywall, carpentry, painting, doors, screens, hardware, caulk, punch-list work, plumbing and electrical issue documentation with licensed-trade routing, and scheduled Home Watch visits for seasonal, second, and vacant homes.

Co-owner Vince Knight, Field Operations Lead, brings journeyman plumbing experience and a Florida property-management background. Standard handyman visits are **$150 first hour / $75 each additional hour**, with specialty work at **$200 first hour / $100 additional**, and **no 2-hour minimum** on small jobs. Home Watch uses separate published plans.

Handyman route expansion: Lutz / North Tampa may be accepted by address confirmation. North Tampa is a neighborhood label, not a separate city office. Knight Group does not maintain a Lutz office. Temple Terrace is a served Hillsborough city with its own page. Home Watch remains Pinellas-focused.

## Home Watch & Seasonal Property Care

- [Pinellas County Home Watch](https://www.knightgroup.com/home-watch-pinellas): Scheduled visual property checks and photo reports for snowbirds, second homes, vacation homes and vacant properties in Pinellas County.
- [Home Watch Pricing](https://www.knightgroup.com/home-watch-pricing): Weekly, biweekly, one-time, premium property-check, vendor-access, and storm-check options.
- [Home Watch Checklist](https://www.knightgroup.com/home-watch-checklist): What Knight Group visually checks during a scheduled Home Watch visit and how findings are reported.
- [Florida Snowbird Departure Checklist](https://www.knightgroup.com/florida-snowbird-departure-checklist): Homeowner close-up list before leaving Florida for the season. Not a Home Watch visit.

Home Watch is a scheduled visual observation and reporting service. It is not a licensed home inspection or private security service. Eligible repairs are quoted separately.
